from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_BUILDER, prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_CHECKER, prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_REVIEWER], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_AGG_PROMPT)
        solution = await star(problem)
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm:
            aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        else:
            aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"], {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}

class prompt_custom:
    CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_BUILDER = """Solve the campsite puzzle by constructing a complete candidate board.

Focus on:
- preserving every tree X exactly,
- placing tents * only on empty cells,
- matching row counts and column counts exactly,
- ensuring each tent is orthogonally adjacent to a tree,
- ensuring tents never touch, even diagonally.

Return exactly one candidate final board wrapped in:
<begin_board>
[board only, one row per line, space-separated symbols]
<end_board>

Do not include explanations."""

    CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_CHECKER = """Solve the campsite puzzle carefully, acting as a constraint-checking specialist.

Prioritize:
- exact row counts,
- exact column counts,
- exact total number of tents,
- no tent-to-tent touching in any of the 8 neighboring directions,
- every tent having at least one orthogonally adjacent tree,
- trees X unchanged.

Return exactly one candidate final board wrapped in:
<begin_board>
[board only, one row per line, space-separated symbols]
<end_board>

Do not include explanations."""

    CAMPSITE_WORKER_PROMPT_REVIEWER = """Solve the campsite puzzle with special attention to tricky edge cases.

Pay extra attention to:
- cells adjacent to multiple trees,
- rows or columns with count 0 or high counts,
- avoiding illegal diagonal tent contact,
- not placing tents on trees,
- producing a fully completed final board.

Return exactly one candidate final board wrapped in:
<begin_board>
[board only, one row per line, space-separated symbols]
<end_board>

Do not include explanations."""
